notes: Account is a regional defense logistics authority — not typical commercial IT.
Must run fully air-gapped in secondary gov datacenter (physically isolated network).
Primary workload: situational awareness assistant that ingests SCADA and telemetry snapshots, plus DOC search for ops manuals.
Strict change control: model updates via signed physical media only; vendor image must pass supply-chain attestation and reproducible build trace.
Quote from CISO: 'No outbound telemetry, no pings back to cloud, and HSM-backed keys for all model artifacts.'
Latency target: <200ms per request for short-context chat reranking paths; batch embedding jobs can be offline overnight.
Throughput target: sustained 200 qps during surge windows; spikes up to 600 qps for simulation exercises (dedicated pool requested).
Cost sensitivity: secondary to security but want clear unit economics for dedicated capacity — will compare to internal-hosted TCO over 3 years.
Preferred models: vetted Llama-family variants quantized to 4-bit for resource predictability, fallback to smaller 7B distilled model for degraded-network tests.
Integration constraints: must integrate with existing PKI and on-prem SSO; SAML + kerberos backend.
Regulatory needs: audit logs retained 7 years, exportable in immutable format; retention controls configurable per dataset.
POC plan: 8-week air-gapped POC on red-teamed image, demonstrates inference correctness and KV-cache behavior under simulated SCADA patterns.
Ask from AE: provide SOW template for on-prem + air-gap plus a draft physical-media handover SOP.
